name: 0.6.0-alpha
body:
## What's Changed
* Release 0.5.0-alpha by @Ph0enixKM in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/845
* chore(github): Set types of issue templates by @lens0021 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/848
* chore(github): Set types of issue templates by @lens0021 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/857
* Add recursion support by @Ph0enixKM in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/827
* Warnings for variables + warning tests by @Ph0enixKM in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/852
* Fix bad array comparison logic by @Ph0enixKM in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/863
* Seq not working on macos by @Ph0enixKM in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/862
* Fix error with passing slice to a function call by @Ph0enixKM in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/861
* Used variable should mark all transitive variables as used by @Ph0enixKM in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/866
* No warnings for global variables by @Ph0enixKM in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/875
* ci: Build nightly by @lens0021 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/871
* ci(nightly): Add manual triggering by @lens0021 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/883
* Fix uncovered warnings in stdlib by @Ph0enixKM in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/878
* Rename nightly build to contain sem-ver of the next patch by @Ph0enixKM in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/881
* Improve performance of standard library by @Ph0enixKM in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/877
* Nightly release should short-circuit in case of no changes by @Ph0enixKM in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/884
* Fix trace issue by @Ph0enixKM in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/873
* Date test occasionally failing by @Ph0enixKM in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/887
* Improve performance of stdlib trim functions by @Ph0enixKM in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/888
* Make for loop over range to translate to a bash for loop. by @Ph0enixKM in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/885
* Use the existing nightly release and update it by @Ph0enixKM in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/896
* Add testing functionality to Amber by @Ph0enixKM in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/865
* Add union types by @Ph0enixKM in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/893
* Add array type inference by @Ph0enixKM in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/892
* Fix shellcheck errors (Validity) by @Ph0enixKM in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/898
* Nesting non-failable in handled failable functions yields warnings by @Ph0enixKM in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/894
* Switch license from GPLv3 to LGPL by @Ph0enixKM in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/662
* Explain the ability to use capture groups in regex_replace by @Ph0enixKM in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/903
* Add support for functions in nameof by @Ph0enixKM in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/904
* Fix propagation error panic by @Ph0enixKM in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/910
* ci: Add rust-problem-matchers for clippy by @lens0021 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/912
* complete fetch() for stdlib/http by @Tirito6626 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/906
* Fix: Allow comments inside array literals by @lens0021 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/913
* fix: Allow comments in function invocation arguments by @lens0021 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/914
* fix: Allow comments in function declaration parameters by @lens0021 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/915
* fix: Allow comments in import statements by @lens0021 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/916
* feat(std): updated symlink_create by @Mte90 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/907
* ci(actions): Address security issues identified by `zizmor` by @lens0021 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/880
* fix: Replace some `$ echo $` in stdlib with printf by @lens0021 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/921
* feat(script): folder by @lens0021 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/918
* Remove PAT token from workflow by @Ph0enixKM in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/930
* ci(dependabot): github-actions setting by @lens0021 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/929
* chore(deps): bump actions/checkout from 4 to 6 in the github-actions group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/932
* README for `scripts/` by @Tirito6626 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/933
* Add array destructing by @Ph0enixKM in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/919
* possible stdlib optimizations by @Tirito6626 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/924
* Fix input prompt not reading when reading from pipe by @Ph0enixKM in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/925
* Update optimizer to mark variables used in indexes as used by @Ph0enixKM in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/934
* ci: Add `zizmor` Security Analysis by @lens0021 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/879
* Move builtins to the new syntax and support old one by @Ph0enixKM in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/936
* Remove testing push trigger of zizmor workflow by @lens0021 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/942
* ci(codecov): Add code coverage reporting by @lens0021 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/928
* Handle comments in if blocks by @nerandell in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/943
* fix: Use PRINTF(1) instead of ECHO(1) for echo module by @lens0021 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/927
* Replace duplicate statement lists by @terror in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/948
* Add control flow analysis by @Ph0enixKM in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/940
* union type for some functions, color names by @Tirito6626 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/953
* docs: Fix glitches and notes by @lens0021 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/959
* feat: Avoid trimming indentation from doc code blocks by @zhfr7 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/957
* Address Amber warnings and improvements by @lens0021 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/964
* reworked functions and tests for #955 by @Tirito6626 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/965
* feat(optimize): remove redundant `__sudo` initialization by @MuhamedMagdi in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/967
* chore(deps): bump the github-actions group with 5 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/970
* feat(stdlib): updated all echo usage examples by @Tirito6626 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/968
* Update actions in rust.yml to specific versions by @lens0021 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/961
* Docs cleanup by @lens0021 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/977
* Fix duplicate function generation in Bash by @Ph0enixKM in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/975
* Remove redundant labels in Github Issue Templates by @Ph0enixKM in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/980
* feat(builtin): touch added by @Mte90 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/909
* fix: `sudo` prefix for `mv` builtin by @MuhamedMagdi in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/983
* Fix comment formatting in uniq_lines documentation by @lens0021 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/984
* Failed and exited should provide an Int exit code by @Ph0enixKM in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/981
* feat(stdlib): add array sort functions by @kryske in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/966
* feat(stdlib): `shopt_enable()` and `shopt_disable()` by @Tirito6626 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/982
* feat(stdlib): file_compress() by @Tirito6626 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/991
* docs: `?` consistency by @lens0021 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/994
* fix(sed_version): remove non-portable `\b` by @52 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/995
* Feat/new builtins by @kryske in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/996
* chore(deps): bump peter-evans/create-pull-request from 8.0.0 to 8.1.0 in the github-actions group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/1001
* ci(codecov): Add release coverage with tag flags by @lens0021 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/952
* refactor: adds rustfmt and formats codebase by @callframe in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/1008
* Disable bash alias and ls/array tests fixed by @Mte90 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/1007
* Adds public variables by @callframe in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/1002
* ci: Pin codecov-action by @lens0021 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/1021
* chore(deps): bump actions/cache from 4 to 5 in the github-actions group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/1022
* Added more tests to improve code coverage by @Mte90 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/1023
* fix: 'es last line being dropped issue closes #1029 by @callframe in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/1030
* Add debian packaging by @PalinuroSec in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/1031
* More tests on other files by @Mte90 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/1032
* feat(package): added rpm build on release by @Mte90 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/1015
* feat(cargo): incremental and threads for tests by @Mte90 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/1014
* fix: 'ing string interpolation close #1016 by @callframe in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/1017
* Fix #321 by @Mte90 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/1033
* chore(deps): bump cachix/install-nix-action from 31.9.0 to 31.9.1 in the github-actions group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/1040
* fix(compiler): remove bc and sed computation from ranges by @Tirito6626 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/1041
* Fix array interpolable expansion by @Tirito6626 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/1042
* Lock builtin, #448 by @Mte90 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/1034
* ci: Add ShellCheck job by @lens0021 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/962
* Add cpad function standard library by @ajwalkiewicz in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/1058
* docs(stdlib): Use `echo()` form in usage docs by @lens0021 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/1060
* fix(cli): when command doesn't exist a nice error by @Mte90 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/1028
* Add zsh and ksh support by @Ph0enixKM in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/1000
* chore(deps): bump the github-actions group across 1 directory with 3 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/1063
* chore(deps): bump the github-actions group with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/1072
* Add `--target`, `shellversion` and Bash 3.2 support by @Ph0enixKM in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/1065
* chore: simplify logic in lowercase and uppercase functions by @Deepak8858 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/1074
* Added check for symbol redeclaration in the same scope by @KrosFire in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/1071
* Added docs in shell function declaration by @KrosFire in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/1076
* chore(deps): bump svenstaro/upload-release-action from 2.11.4 to 2.11.5 in the github-actions group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/1077
* Created "Index out of bounds" runtime error by @KrosFire in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/1075
* Bumped version to 0.6.0-alpha by @KrosFire in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/1078
* Grammar.ebnf generator by @Mte90 in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/1027
* Improve setup scripts by @KrosFire in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/1080
* chore(deps): bump the github-actions group with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/1085
* chore(deps): bump the github-actions group with 4 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/1088
* Staging fixes by @KrosFire in https://github.com/amber-lang/amber/pull/1084
